bias.zh: 中性 · 收复 $368–372 均线区

read.en: Tesla rose 1.5% on Oct 20 to $373.71, trading between $363.64 and $377.59. It is above the falling 5-day ($365.2), rising 30-day ($368.3), falling 100-day ($369.7) and falling 10-day ($371.5) averages, but below the falling 200-day ($387.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and is above zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($384.87), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: 特斯拉 10月20日上涨 1.5%，收于 $373.71，盘中区间 $363.64–377.59。股价位于下行的 5 日（$365.2）、上行的 30 日（$368.3）、下行的 100 日（$369.7）和下行的 10 日均线（$371.5）上方，但仍低于下行的 200 日均线（$387.3）。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$384.87），RSI 为 54。

read.en: The close cleared the $368–372 cluster (30, 100 and 10-day averages) and it now becomes support. Resistance is $377.6 (the day's high and Oct 12 low), then $388 (cap since March, 200-day average, SAR) and $418 (January highs). Support is $368–372, then $365.2 (5-day) and $354 (Sep 15 low). A close above $388 would target $418; a close below $365 would reopen $354.
read.zh: 收盘突破 $368–372 均线密集区（30 日、100 日和 10 日均线），该区域转为支撑。阻力为 $377.6（当日高点及 10月12日低点），其次 $388（3月以来的上限、200 日均线、SAR）和 $418（1月高点）。支撑为 $368–372，其次 $365.2（5 日均线）和 $354（9月15日低点）。若收盘站上 $388，下一目标看 $418；若收盘跌破 $365，将重新打开 $354。

r.en: $388 cap since March plus the 200-day average and SAR
